title: LG00: a kernel-checked KAM torus of Locatelli–Giorgilli's secular Sun–Jupiter–Saturn model
note: Side campaign (lemma.farm). LG00 now goes by the packed certifier route (owner decision, 1 Nov). The certificate data and kernel shards live on local branches and are never part of KAM-dev's default build (separate repository pending, owner decision). The orchestrator updates this file when a stage completes; weights are the stages' relative effort.

stages.name: Diophantine lemmas for the frequency directions (Lean)
stages.evidence: branch lg00-prep: KAM/Planetary/LG00 (isDiophantine_rP, isDiophantine_rPP), standard axioms

stages.name: certificate-data generator and exact dry run
stages.evidence: branches lg00-prep and lg00-cert: generator with the exact sqrt Hamiltonian and Hermitian-averaged torus; all seven landed sub-checks pass in the exact dry runs at L = 20 (err 8.1e-18) and L = 21 (err 1.1e-18)

stages.name: pilot: kernel cost measured on representative shards
stages.evidence: branch lg00-cert f12f3db4, docs/campaign/handoffs/LG00-CERT.md: every check kind kernel-checked on L = 8 data (jet bridge, Hamiltonian bounds, static, embedding, plan, regular, product, witness, sqrt and inv segments, energy, an invariance row), each under 6.1 GB; budget gate passed (route A refined at L = 20, about 26 CPU-h projected, range 13-40)

stages.name: kernel certificate of a torus in LG00's Γ′ family and the closed theorem
stages.evidence: branch lg00-cert cdd6a9e9: lg00_kamTorus and lg00_physical_torus proved, standard axioms only (orchestrator-checked); 5183 kernel modules at L = 20, 31.4 CPU-h; statement byte-identical to the audited draft (AUDIT-LG00-STMT-1); torus on energy level E₀, about 1e-12 relative from the real orbit's energy

stages.name: T′ at the exact energy of LG00's initial point (re-solve and re-certify)
stages.evidence: T′ at the exact energy E*: proved twice. Existing route (run18): 5,241 kernel modules, 29.9 CPU-h, standard axioms. Packed route: 881 modules, 2.84 CPU-h (about 11x less), standard axioms; independent audits PROD/CONS/JETROUTE passed with changes.

stages.name: second torus T″ (confinement between two tori)
stages.evidence: T″ on E* in T′'s chart (window Γ″): proved by the packed route only (run18 stopped by owner decision): 592 modules, 1.75 CPU-h, standard axioms; carried to LG00's own certificate by a definitional bridge.

stages.name: confinement theorem in Lean (the real orbit trapped forever between T′ and T″)
stages.evidence: LG00.Confinement.lg00_confinement (built 1 Nov 22:26 UTC): no hypotheses, axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only (independent walk over 96,288 constants). The Table 3 orbit of model (11) is global, unique, on its energy level, with normal-mode actions in the box, and stays strictly between the certified tori T′ and T″. Independent audit AUDIT-LG00-CONF-PACKED-1: PASS WITH CHANGES (statement additions proposed for the owner; packaging).

stages.name: independent audit and separate repository
stages.evidence: audits done: first torus (AUDIT-LG00-PROOF-1), packed route (PROD, CONS, JETROUTE), confinement (AUDIT-LG00-CONF-PACKED-1); self-contained release package building; separate repository pending
